Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.messenger

Class IrcMessage

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.messenger.IrcMessage
public final class IrcMessage extends Object
One parsed IRC protocol line (RFC 2812 grammar): 
   message    =  [ ":" prefix SPACE ] command [ params ]
   prefix     =  servername / ( nickname [ "!" user ] [ "@" host ] )
   params     =  *13( SPACE middleparam ) [ SPACE ":" trailingparam ]

This is a pure value type with no I/O: parse(String) and toLine() are the single, well-tested point where wire text becomes structure and back, so the rest of the client never hand-splits a line.

    • of

    • parse

      public static IrcMessage parse(String line)
      Parses one IRC line. Returns null for a null/blank line. The parser is tolerant: a malformed prefix (missing :) is treated as the command, and everything after the first : in the param list is a single trailing parameter (which may contain spaces).
      Parameters:
      line - the raw line, without the CR/LF terminator
      Returns:
      the parsed message, or null
